purpose: Teach: 変貌/賛美/洞察/バリュー/感度/時速/不必要/インタフェース

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、業界の変貌に的確に対応された
lines.en: Dad was remarkably precise in adapting to how the industry transformed around us.
lines.style: Gentle, measured voice. Speaking as if calling a memory into the room. Slow cadence, each phrase deliberate. A son remembering his father with quiet admiration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員を賛美する経営をされた
lines.en: Yes. He led by bringing out the best in the people around him.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Direct eye contact in the voice. Warm but grounded—not sentimental. The tone of someone who lived it and understood it fully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、人を洞察する力に長けてらした
lines.en: He had a gift for understanding people—seeing what others missed.
lines.style: Wistful, slightly distant. Breathing room between phrases. The voice of someone reaching back into time, touching something irretrievable. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品のバリューを大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. He never lost sight of what made our products matter.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Each word placed deliberately. Warm reflection without nostalgia—the clarity that comes from lived understanding. Grounded in principle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、市場の感度を持って商品を開発された
lines.en: He could feel what the market wanted before it was obvious. That's how he built.
lines.style: Nostalgic but not indulgent. Speaking with the slow certainty of looking back. Slight emphasis on 'how'—the method mattered. Trailing into contemplation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは時速の経営判断をされた
lines.en: Yes. He made decisions quickly when they mattered, but he never rushed.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost gentle. A subtle distinction being drawn—speed without haste. The voice of someone who inherited a discipline and respects it deeply.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、不必要な投資を控えられた
lines.en: He was disciplined about what not to do. That's a rare thing.
lines.style: Appreciative precision. Not loud, but clear. There's weight in the observation—a son acknowledging something his father taught him by example. Steady throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは顧客インタフェースを大切にされた
lines.en: Yes. He understood that business is built on knowing your customers—really knowing them.
lines.style: Final affirmation, still warm but with a sense of closure. The voice finding ground. Measured, complete. As if summarizing something both men have come to understand together.
